svg.title: Fiber 90-degree bend — left to downward
svg.desc: Editable quarter-circle fiber segment with a horizontal tangent at the left end and a downward vertical tangent at the lower end. Continuous pale gray cladding surrounds a blue core, matching the component library. There are no labels, direction arrows, outer outlines or enclosing box. Geometry is schematic and does not specify a physical bend radius. All artwork is native SVG on a transparent background. Cladding and core are separate Inkscape layers.
